summary: Routed-datapath LVS ran a compare under released klt 0.9.0 and reports status mismatch. The layout side extracted 0 devices against 29356 in the reference, so nothing matched; the pin-name-case refusal recorded in r4 no longer occurs. Not a match and not evidence of one.
note: ASAP7 is predictive; tool result only. Append-only; item4-slice-attempt.r2.json and item4-attempts.json are left as written. The netlist, layout and deck were not edited and no option was waived.
request_notes: Byte-identical to evidence/item4-lvs/slice_routed.r3.request.json. pdk_root and pin_order_files point at the pinned lambdapdk v0.2.17 tree (archive sha256 ac7e950c4d0394a829658b6e219fea4a4b0c61a998183d5520f8b9e38c6efff2, verified, unpacked in /tmp scratch, not committed).
klt_message_note: No refusal message under klt 0.9.0: the compare ran and exit 3 is the mismatch result. The r4 refusal text is not repeated here; see item4-slice-attempt.r4.json.
upstream: 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#4815 (closed): the refusal it reported no longer occurs in 0.9.0
not_done: The netlist, layout, deck and options were not edited to force a match; no option was waived (power_connectivity and supply_nets untouched, per decision 0005). finfet_bulk is the same assertion as r2 to r4 and the report flags it as device.finfet_bulk_tied warnings.
klt_source: throwaway uvx env, uvx --with klayout --from klayout-tools==0.9.0 klt (host klt 0.9.1.dev18 not used; host tool not changed)
observed: counts.devices layout 0 / reference 29356; nets 2775 / 15718; pins 201 / 266; matched 0 in each. Top circuit slice/SLICE 'could not be matched to a counterpart'; 200 anchored top-level pins rejected as hints. net.supply_fragmented on 84 library-cell circuits (VDD in 2 layout nets). The reference conversion case-folded RESETN/SETN on DFFASRHQNx1_ASAP7_75t_R (reference.gate_level_pin_case_folded, warning).
cause_not_determined: Why the layout extracts no devices (whether the routed GDS carries transistor-level geometry for the placed standard cells) was not investigated here; it is not claimed.
